title: Through Mont Blanc to Strasbourg
route: Courmayeur → Mont Blanc Tunnel → Chamonix → Switzerland → Strasbourg
introTitle: Through Mont Blanc and across Switzerland.
intro: Departing Courmayeur, I crossed into France through the Mont Blanc Tunnel and emerged near Chamonix beneath the Alps. I continued through Switzerland, passing vineyards, rolling hills, and views of Lake Geneva, before reaching Strasbourg. This was the actual route taken, replacing the earlier Great St. Bernard Tunnel plan.
